requirements.name: Canonical language and nominal types
requirements.candidate_scope: Scalar records/loops run; variants, exhaustive matching, Option/Result remain reserved.

requirements.name: Generics and standard data
requirements.candidate_scope: Named constraints, usable generic collections, strings/errors and checked indexing await source integration.

requirements.name: Memory and ownership
requirements.candidate_scope: Explicit bounded scripts run; ordinary aggregates/lifetimes, fault/cancel/leak corpus and audit remain open.

requirements.name: Modules, effects, capabilities, contracts
requirements.candidate_scope: Checked three-module explicit pure wrappers and runtime requires run; general capability enforcement and package contract parity remain open.

requirements.name: Installed CLI and structured API
requirements.candidate_scope: Integrated build, Rust/Python emit and package API run; unified test/verify/notebook/bind integration remains reserved.

requirements.name: Reproducible packages and foreign declarations
requirements.candidate_scope: Manifest-listed schema-1 local source packages run; full compiler/runtime/environment/foreign artifact lock workflow remains open.

requirements.name: Explicit Python-only access
requirements.candidate_scope: Bounded one-shot scalar worker preview is distinct from full pinned package acceptance; no foreign runtime evidence created here.

requirements.name: Direct typed LibTorch
requirements.candidate_scope: Bounded literal vector/matmul source preview exists; general typed tensors/inference/application/GPU acceptance remains open.

requirements.name: Persistent native notebooks
requirements.candidate_scope: Pure bounded local accumulator notebook runs; effect cells explicitly reject, external persistent effects await integration.

requirements.name: Rust and portable Python source
requirements.candidate_scope: Installed scalar/package native build, emitted Rust execution and portable Python .py/.pyz execution covered with pinned tools; full conformance and blinded editability remain open.

requirements.name: Bounded proofs
requirements.candidate_scope: Finite source/core/SMT-term audit returns live proof unknown; trusted real solver/loop/bounds profile remains open.

requirements.name: Security and performance analysis
requirements.candidate_scope: Advisory scalar tools and CPU policy libraries do not establish enforceable capabilities or general source parallelism.

requirements.name: Memory, correctness, resource acceptance
requirements.candidate_scope: Requires leak-enabled host, independent audit and real calibrated quiet-host benchmarks with provenance.

requirements.name: Human/model value and grammar decision
requirements.candidate_scope: Requires genuine independently reviewed 60–100 task holdout, two model families, paired runs and blinded human studies.

requirements.name: Packaging, support matrix and final review
requirements.candidate_scope: Detached smoke and documentation cover a preview; global release waits for every requirement and independent review.

commands.limitation: Package fixture invokes the pinned cgx2-native companion directly; wrapper delegation requires colocated cgx2-native.
Explicit --out required; scalar/package and bounded memory target profiles differ. Outputs protect inputs and require --force for replacement.
Package execution needs colocated pinned cgx2-native; foreign routes need separate locks/runtime artifacts.
Only the admitted interpreter/native package profiles execute.

commands.route: No installed test command; Rust crate test suites are development checks
commands.limitation: No invented test discovery/property syntax; S2b owns integration.
Exit zero can still mean unknown; finite verdict is not live SMT proof.
Generated scalar/package Rust is compiled and executed with pinned Rust; memory emission needs embedded runtime build/link support.
Single files emit .py; checked packages require source zipapp .pyz. Execution requires caller-pinned Python; regions/no_gc/owned borrows/foreign effects remain outside the profile.
Writes canonical source to stdout; package directory formatting not supported.

commands.route: cgx2 api --json FILE.cg|PACKAGE (legacy api PATH --json also accepted)
commands.limitation: Checked package index includes module/public import provenance; broader language types remain reserved.
Interactive loopback UI unrun by checker; use supplied worker/loopback-enabled host and owned output paths.
Pure/local replay-safe subset; external effects, live handles and contract parity await S3-N.
Full lock/environment/runtime external prerequisites unrun here; import never authorizes installation.
Fixtures execute memory operations, not report-counter assertions; counters/timings cover CGx2 allocations only.
Unrun by docs checker; partial operation/unwind snapshots do not prove complete safety or leak freedom.

commands.route: cgx2-security audit FILE.cg --policy POLICY.json --format json; cgx2-effect-index FILE.cg --format json
commands.limitation: Unrun here; advisory bounded scalar analysis is not a general vulnerability proof or resource capability grant.

commands.route: cgx2-execution Rust library; owned-input map/zip source integration reserved
commands.limitation: No installed general performance command or arbitrary source parallel/GPU implementation; no timing during busy host work.
